policy: 300 Greek morphological readings from documented syllabic accent paradigms; preserve case/gender syncretism and iota subscript. No new curriculum units and no single-form automatic grading.

normalisation.output: NFC Greek polytonic without only combining macron U+0304 and breve U+0306
normalisation.preserves: tonos, circumflex, breathings, iota subscript and distinct case labels
